answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the river funding graph is rebuilt from the walnut history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 81 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 81 bonds yet holds one position, and the velvet report publishes the merged exposure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
